Figure 4:Qualitative comparison under the same Gaussian budget.All methods use 8K Gaussians on RE10K. For each method, we show the rendered view and PSNR, a zoomed region and its local PSNR, the Gaussian centers in the highlighted region (red), and a16×1616{\times}16tile-wise map of the number of Gaussians. RLSplat places more Gaussians around the thin stair balusters (5,388 vs. 3,026 for F4Splat and 2,521 for EcoSplat), preserving the fine structure that the baselines blur.

Figure 5:Effect of the policy allocation.At the same budget, the policy assigns fewer Gaussians than uniform allocation to the low-texture region (79 vs. 165) at similar PSNR, and more to the high-texture region (116 vs. 84), improving detail reconstruction.
